**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Start a brain session and continue #397 (M4 — plain-copy clobber asymmetry). The design was already ratified and pushed; the job was the implementation, delivered as a 4-slice chained-PR sequence.

## Instructions the owner gave
- Chain strategy: **feature-branch-chain** (tracker `feature/issue-397-clobber-asymmetry`), so #397 stays open until every slice lands. Only the tracker carries `Closes #397`.
- Slices 1+2 shipped together in one PR; slices 3 and 4 as child PRs.
- REQ-397-6 scope: **regenerate-and-compare, narrowed to AGENTS.md**, with the non-generated paths tracked as a follow-up.

## Accomplished
Complete 4-slice chain, all green:
- **#429** — slices 1+2 (`e18e407`, `351a1f2`): signed classification as data (`STRATEGY`/`managedStrategy`), three-way modification detection via `readOutgoing()`, REFUSE gate + per-path `--force-managed`.
- **#434** — slice 3 (`febb213`): `.gemini/settings.json` merged; `AGENTS.md` off the copy set and regenerated.
- **#437** — slice 4 (`fd9d0b2`): already-clobbered detection (`brain/scripts/lib/agents-clobber.mjs`), docs closure.
- All three PRs: 8/8 governance checks PASS, `type:bug`, correct bases.
- Suite grew 2349 → 2381, all green. Review surface: 317 + 54 + 55 lines, no `size:exception` anywhere.
- Filed **#433** (session:start 20-minute block) and **#436** (shipped-hash manifest, Tier-2 follow-up).

## Discoveries — repo and tooling
- **`actor-check.mjs:405` — issue-link is ASYMMETRIC by base.** `base=main` REQUIRES `Closes|Fixes|Resolves #N`; `Part of #N` is rejected there. `base!=main` also accepts `Part of #N`. This is what makes the feature-branch chain the only way to ship slices without auto-closing the parent.
- **`brain:check` issueLink inspects COMMITS on the branch, not the working tree.** "Refs #N" does NOT satisfy it.
- **`gh pr edit` is broken here** — fails with `GraphQL: Projects (classic) is being deprecated ... (repository.pullRequest.projectCards)` and applies NOTHING. Workaround: `jq -n --arg t "<title>" --rawfile b body.md '{title:$t,body:$b}' | gh api -X PATCH repos/csrinaldi/brain/pulls/<N> --input -`. Always verify with `gh pr view`.
- **`sd` is not installed** and invoking it triggers a sudo prompt that fails. Use the Edit tool for in-place source mutation.
- **brain's diff-size counter excludes `**/*.test.mjs`** via `governance.ignoreList`. Run `git diff --numstat <base> | node brain/scripts/vcs/diff-size-count.mjs` for the number the gate uses.
- **`npm run session:start` takes ~20 minutes**, blocked in `memory/cli.mjs import` (full re-import of 1722 records / 18 MB, no watermark), emitting nothing until done. Exit 0. → #433.

## Discoveries — technical, load-bearing
- **`antigravity.mjs#init()` writes BOTH `AGENTS.md` AND `.gemini/settings.json`.** Calling it plainly to satisfy REQ-397-4 overwrites the `.gemini` merge REQ-397-3 performs earlier in the SAME run. Fix: `_writeGeminiSettings: () => {}`.
- **Regeneration must run AFTER the managed copy** — it reads methodology docs the copy just updated. CODE from the script's own sibling, DATA from `ROOT`.
- **Removing `AGENTS.md` from `managed` strands nobody** — `bootstrap.sh:263` runs `harness/cli.mjs init`, which generates it. Always check the fresh-install path before removing a managed entry.
- **`strategyFor` must give exact literals priority over globs** — `brain/scripts/ci/gitlab-governance.yml` is REFUSE under the `brain/scripts/**` COPY glob.
- **Git history is unusable for clobber detection**: brain's own `AGENTS.md` changed 16 times across 17 tags, so a history rule fires for nearly every consumer — the exact thing REQ-397-6 Scenario 2 forbids. Measured, then rejected.
- **A negative control cannot be proven RED by deleting the feature.** With no detector, nothing fires, so it passes for the wrong reason. Prove it by MUTATION — removing the Scenario-2 gate failed exactly the two negative controls and nothing else.
- **Assert behaviour, not spelling.** A test pinning the literal `--force-managed` in the tag-parse line broke on a `VALUE_FLAGS` refactor while the invariant held. Rewritten to assert the missing-tag guard fires.

## Process mistake worth remembering
PR #429 was open as **design-only, "slice 1 of 2"**, with implementation planned as a CHILD PR. I committed the implementation onto the same branch, folding both into #429. Once pushed, splitting would need a force-push on a published branch — `AGENTS.md` Tier 3, prohibited. Remedy was amending the PR description honestly, noting design and implementation stay separable by commit. **Check for an existing open PR on the branch BEFORE the first implementation commit.**

## Next Steps
- Merge the chain bottom-up: #437 → #434 → #429 → tracker → `main` with `Closes #397`.
- Run `npm run memory:share` before the tracker merges (memory-gate checklist item is still unchecked on all three PRs).
- **Task 3.7 stays PARTIAL**: the REFUSE gate needs `outgoing !== incoming`, unreachable via `--no-install`. Belongs to #401's container harness.
- #436 needs a Tier-2 draft + signature before implementation.
- #433 (session:start) is unassigned and unstarted.

## Relevant Files
- `brain/core/managed-paths.mjs` — `STRATEGY` + `managedStrategy`, the signed table as data; `AGENTS.md` removed from `managed`
- `brain/scripts/lib/installer.mjs` — `strategyFor()`, `readOutgoing()`, `copyManaged` three-way + REFUSE gate
- `brain/scripts/brain-upgrade.mjs` — step 0 snapshot, `--force-managed`, refusal report, step 4 regeneration + clobber detection
- `brain/scripts/lib/agents-clobber.mjs` — new pure detector (REQ-397-6)
- `docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md` — #397 entry closed with three named residuals
- `openspec/changes/issue-397-clobber-asymmetry/` — spec.md carries the REQ-397-6 narrowing and its justification; tasks.md fully rendered
